Parent: https://github.com/innosage-llc/innosage-tools/issues/102

## Locked purpose and authority

Founder approved this narrowed subissue: determine feasibility of unchanged, pinned default RxDB17.6.0 Google Drive replication/Master Wins plus a small device-local protection layer, using mock-only, CLI-first, fixture-driven verification. A verified feasible route OR a precise evidenced impossibility/decision boundary is an acceptable research deliverable. Do not engineer a green result by changing the hypothesis.

Research is authorized autonomously within these boundaries. No GUI work, real Google Drive/OAuth configuration/API calls, external service setup, paid resources, deployment, Master closure, cleanup/reset or owner-controlled84/85 session/worktree operations. Reuse existing fixtures/source/evidence. Follow current V4 routing where actually supported; distinguish requested/observed roles and do not claim native Astra admission from catalog/config text.

## Three acceptance criteria (feasibility oracle)

**C1 — Intent survives default Master Wins.** Two local synthetic devices, one workspace, one writer/session per device: A→B locally acknowledged; independent A→C remote; then local B→D while remote C→E. Explicit native sync selects E in replicated pages while full local D and required B/C conflict baselines remain recoverable. Unresolved D is not silently reuploaded. Another page propagates while conflict remains. Journal persists before ACK; representative crash/reopen recovers acknowledged text. Reuse existing native IndexedDB/headless CLI receipts where source is unchanged; fake-indexeddb same-process reopen alone is not real persistent crash proof.

**C2 — Resolution cannot falsely retire intent.** Explicit cloud discard and one local recommit path (Keep local OR manual body via the same normal native-write contract). Verify actual remote content before cleanup. Adversarial E during commit or successful mutation with lost response must retain unverified local intent and truthful state. Repeated verify/cleanup must not retire a newer edit. No custom conflict policy or transport bypass.

**C3 — Native discovery is sufficient.** Thirty remotely present complete documents sharing a timestamp must reach a cold replica. Separately hide an older edit, advance the cursor with a newer edit, restore visibility, and explicitly sync: recover the older edit under the frozen bounded schedule. Independent remote inventory/full bodies are ground truth. Missing discovery is FAIL, never deletion or overlay success. Investigate supported native/default configurations and mock fidelity causally; preserve the unchanged implementation identity.

Explicit native synchronization is permitted and labeled EXPLICIT_SYNC_ONLY. No injected event or wake may masquerade as unattended behavior. Original F04 unattended evidence remains BLOCKED/NOT_PROVEN and is not overwritten by this narrower contract.

## Verdict and completion

- GO only if C1–C3 PASS for the unchanged pinned native implementation and stated faithful mock assumptions. It means offline explicit-sync feasibility, not real Google/product approval.
- CONDITIONAL only if no decisive safety/discovery counterexample exists but an exact assumption or proof gap remains; never use it to hide a failed essential criterion.
- NO-GO for a decisive acknowledged-intent/retirement/discovery counterexample or a remedy requiring a changed hypothesis. A complete explained NO-GO is valid completion of this research subissue; fixture FAIL remains FAIL.

Research completion requires C1–C3 evidence mapping (actual PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, source/oracle hashes, complete-body traces, replay commands and limitations), independent review of the technical conclusion/changes where applicable, and an objective verdict. It does not require forcing all fixture rows green. Any actual code changes still use owning repository review/native CI/initially draft PR flow.

Deliver only a short existing-runner CLI sequence, one compact machine-readable C1–C3 map, and a short verdict/decision boundary. Reuse valid evidence before running anything new. Run a new fixture only when its result could change the decision; freeze the expected oracle before a fix. Stop/pivot on native-owned counterexamples, unexpected external endpoints, unsafe cleanup, unbounded retry or missing source/oracle binding. Initial narrow runs: at most1000 loopback HTTP requests and180s per scenario invocation; budget exhaustion is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS. These are per-experiment resource stops, not aggregate V4 token/research-cycle ceilings.

## Exclusions and hypothesis boundary

Defer GUI/editor/cursor/compare-widget acceptance, unattended delivery, multi-tab/workspace/leadership product qualification, exhaustive fault permutations, performance/scale qualification, new100-seed campaigns and a V4 framework-proof project. Preserve existing implementation and historical evidence without promoting deferred rows to PASS.

A native fork, replication/discovery policy change, custom conflict handler, provider/version change or new architecture is a CHANGED HYPOTHESIS requiring separate explicit scope. App-owned protection or a demonstrated fixture-fidelity repair is in scope; a local journal cannot repair native failure to discover unseen remote data. Larger finite batch/overfetch values alone do not establish general discovery correctness. Do not silently replace native replication, add a custom polling engine, import Draft infrastructure or revive84.

Mocks establish behavior/counterexamples under stated protocol assumptions, not Google consistency/OAuth/latency/cost or real-provider defects. No real-provider proof is authorized or required to return an explicitly mock-scoped negative result. A later affirmative real-Drive claim would need separately approved synthetic account/folder/scopes/request/byte/time/spend/cleanup bounds and minimal two-client explicit-sync/protection/resolution/listing proof. Deployment/product adoption remain separate.

## Preserved baseline evidence

- Tools PR104 backend and PR105 diagnostic UI/evidence: https://github.com/innosage-llc/innosage-tools/pull/105 ; immutable evidence source c43f4cc1b3d16aa3df1a5365fca26e9a51cbc760.
- Final packet: https://github.com/innosage-llc/innosage-tools/issues/102#issuecomment-6379151631
- Evidence digest e108b0a050ceabd3b45a4a959fef15fdadf15ae6233c3a1286eae2d02f7de98b;100/100 seeded schedules and622 ACKs support bounded local protection, not unattended/discovery proof.
- F04 unattended NOT_PROVEN; F16 cold16/30 despite30 remote plus hidden-old-edit failure. Preserve original raw failures; do not infer deletion.
title: [BYOS Research] CLI feasibility: stock RxDB Drive + local protection (C1–C3)
